description: This file defines the Schedule management class for broadcast scheduling, including nested classes for notification handling and section parsing, with methods for scanning, loading, and managing tuner states within the Thunder::Broadcast namespace.

classes.name: Schedules
classes.description: Manages broadcast schedules, handles tuner notifications, and parses EIT sections.

classes.name: Schedules::Sink
classes.description: Implements ITuner::INotification to handle tuner activation, deactivation, and state changes.

classes.name: Schedules::Parser
classes.description: Parses DVB EIT sections, manages scanning of actual and other tables, and loads schedule data.

methods.name: Schedules::Scan
methods.description: Starts or stops scanning for broadcast schedules.

methods.name: Schedules::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles tuner deactivation events, removing the tuner from the internal list.

methods.name: Schedules::StateChange
methods.description: Handles tuner state changes, adding or removing scanners based on tuner activity.

methods.name: Schedules::Load
methods.description: Loads DVB EIT data into the schedule management system.
